# Content Status

## Summary
Three states, one click apart: Planned → In Progress → Done. No approval stages
— a solo creator reviewing their own work is not a workflow.

## Composition
`nextContentStatus()` cycles, wrapping, and treats an unset status as entering at
the first stage, which is what makes the one-click change in the app safe on a
piece that has never been touched. Hues route through `stateColor` like every
other state colour in this realm.

## Recorded gap
The matrix **Status** concept is audited "Extract from listing" — a generic
option set with a transition graph already exists inside the catalog blog app.
This field is a local stand-in so the app could ship, recorded against that
concept rather than hand-rolled silently. It is the third status enum in this
realm waiting on the shared block.
